sections.title: What Is an ATS-Friendly Resume?
sections.content:
An applicant tracking system (ATS) helps employers collect and organise applications; some workflows also search or filter application details. An ATS-friendly resume uses readable text, conventional headings and relevant information that can be parsed and reviewed. No format or online score guarantees shortlisting.

Use standard labels such as Education, Skills, Projects and Experience, keep dates consistent, and include job-description terms only when they truthfully describe your background.

sections.content:
